summary:
# 今日社区动态（deepseek-flash | 2026-11-19 ~ 2026-11-21）

- ⚡ arm64 新增拷贝与校验和融合例程，省去一次数据遍历，提升网络收包校验吞吐（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- ⚡ ARM64 PMU 分区落地，vPMU 计数器按 vCPU/组隔离，减少上下文切换并提升嵌套虚拟化性能（[Virtualization](#subsystem-Virtualization)）
- 🔧 各架构 syscall 表合并为共享表，单点定义即可生成各架构入口，避免新增系统调用遗漏（[Architecture](#subsystem-Architecture)）
- 🐛 fork 时按 PTE 路径同样复制 PMD，修复 fork 大 THP 进程的性能退化（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）
- ⚡ rwsem 在高优先级等待者被阻塞时对持锁者做优先级提升，缓解优先级反转导致的调度延迟（[Core Kernel](#subsystem-Core%20Kernel)）
- ✨ 引入私有 NUMA 节点，把设备与 DAX 内存作为独立节点纳入内存管理并接入 cpuset、mempolicy 与 sysfs（[Memory](#subsystem-Memory)）

## Drivers
- `perf` `bugfix` DRM 7.4-rc4 修复集，涉及 ivpu、qaic、rocket、amdgpu atpx 等设备问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/CAPM=9ty1FBin9jGz8CoumpTTBOe-LB_Qs5RNn_uMJMbMGTYmyQ@mail.gmail.com/)
- `perf` 新增 AD7625/AD7626 ADC 驱动并扩展 LTC2387、ADAQ2387x，含 PWM 触发支持 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119112437.197306-1-Nicolae-daniel.Deaconescu@analog.com/)
- 新增 LG V60（sm8250）设备树，配套 LG SW43103 面板与 SW42902 触摸驱动 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120155450.7719-1-rofikcoga@gmail.com/)
- 新增 dma-buf 映射类型抽象与 mapping 辅助层，ivpu/qaic/habanalabs/CMA heap 改用，统一不同映射语义 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-dma_mapping_type_v4-v3-0-c0183a409bdf@nvidia.com/)
- `perf` `other` i2c acpi 将 DLL0945 100 kHz quirk 限定到 Dell Precision 5560 与 XPS 15 9510 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119143218.586632-2-pmenzel@molgen.mpg.de/)
- `perf` `bugfix` Input ff-memless 修复 s16 取反溢出导致的 180 度力反馈方向反转 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119170443.1513294-1-irogers@google.com/)
- of_iommu 支持 iommu-ranges 属性，IOMMU 核心可按 DT 描述建立地址映射，AMD/Intel/virtio 与 VFIO type1 同步适配 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-add_iommu_ranges-v8-0-d90486973b73@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- gpiolib-shared 改为基于 fwnode 遍历属性，property/OF 增加 for_each_property 辅助，共享 GPIO 可脱离 DT 使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-fwnode-for-each-prop-v3-0-808e304dc73e@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- LED class 允许 multicolor/flash 设备注册自定义 sysfs 组，避免与核心属性冲突，ktd202x 先行使用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120212431.152081-1-W_Armin@gmx.de/)
- IIO 把 iio_dev_attr 拆成类型化核心属性，buffer/event/dmaengine 改用新接口，减少样板并提升类型安全 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-iio-core-attr-review-v1-0-05b41f8133c2@analog.com/)
- 另有 64 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-drm-reset-state-flag-v12-0-42d63d7417fc@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-superm1-backlight-property-v12-0-89d5217d3618@amd.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-msm-dp-mst-v9-0-ca61be4edfc3@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-vkms-all-config-v6-0-78ace90f4fc1@bootlin.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795171088.git.u.kleine-koenig@baylibre.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119100513.433044-1-prakriti@synopsys.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/87pkvzmxe5.wl-tiwai@suse.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-swnode-kobject-parent-ref-v2-1-7ff8bd54e526@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119071043.2943-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120124607.2799-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-gpiolib-chip-removal-v7-0-aambrozewicz@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119100928.2740-1-sreekuttan2156239@gmail.com/) 等 64 项

## Architecture
- `perf` coresight ETM 支持在 PMU 事件时脉冲外部输出，实现硬件事件与 trace 采集的硬件同步触发 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795182850.git.aaupov@fb.com/)
- 引入 __must_init 并要求显式提供 kobj_type::release，编译期暴露遗漏的释放回调 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119192520.1983406-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` 将 ARM/ARM64/LoongArch/Xtensa 的硬件断点通知推迟到 task_work，避免在异常上下文触发信号 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120144553.TjgAd_G6@linutronix.de/)
- `perf` 各架构 syscall 表合并为共享表，减少重复维护与新增系统调用遗漏，单点定义即可生成各架构入口 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-tonyk-syscall_table-v10-0-a7c9ebd900f6@igalia.com/)
- `perf` 为 CIX Sky1 启用 Panthor GPU 支持，含 devfreq 与电源管理接入 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119123850.2994625-1-cunyuan.liu@cixtech.com/)
- `perf` 新增 Wave6 视频编解码驱动，支持对应 SoC 的硬件编解码 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795075577.git.nas.chung@chipsnmedia.com/)
- `other` stackdepot 以压缩帧形式存储栈记录，降低内存占用，并为 x86/arm64 增加架构钩子 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119153143.4099483-1-matt@readmodwrite.com/)
- `perf` arm64 新增拷贝与 Internet 校验和融合例程，省去一次数据遍历，提升网络收包校验吞吐 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120220330.1067165-1-demyansh@gmail.com/)
- `perf` rkvdec 增加 VDPU346 变体支持，扩展 Rockchip 解码器覆盖的芯片型号 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795191822.git.daniel@makrotopia.org/)
- `perf` `other` USB core 依据 connector 配对不同主控上的端口，正确推断端口间的兄弟关系 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-usb-port-pairing-v6-0-32bd7e36e426@gmail.com/)
- 另有 69 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119111217.902071-1-sumitg@nvidia.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119213147.1094488-1-usama.arif@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-gta3xllte-usb-battery-v1-0-0cf5f763522e@mentallysanemainliners.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-smmu_interconnect_addition-v4-0-cab8ee8be0b3@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-enable-byte-cntr-for-ctcu-v24-0-2d792c6b4819@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-qce-fix-self-tests-v12-0-b5a2a44bc5ae@oss.qualcomm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120174751.49247-1-afd@ti.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-molokai-soc-v3-0-403d763685d9@yahoo.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-dcif-upstreaming-v13-0-966ac248773f@oss.nxp.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-iep2-v3-0-e94eb9f629d2@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-cv75-soc-v12-0-e5a03cca8b05@ambarella.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-shikra-el2-v7-0-9d9000eb50d4@oss.qualcomm.com/) 等 69 项

## Scheduling
- `perf` 多 CPU IPI 发送前增加内存屏障，保证 x86 LDT/TLB 刷新在多核间的顺序可见性。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120224758.04F70CD8@davehans-spike.ostc.intel.com/)
- 提出 rootns：以 fd 绑定的进程闭包命名空间，新增系统调用、ioctl 号与用户态文档。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121000844.1863324-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- 命名空间根 v4：为命名空间根引入独立命名空间，同步更新各架构 syscall 表。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119224312.1037966-1-jarkko@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `bugfix` copy_process 失败时清空 p->mm，避免失败 fork 残留 mm 引用影响后续统计。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-mm_failed_fork-v1-1-b3019f43d197@kernel.org/)
- 用户命名空间支持按命名空间的能力边界集，改动 cred、prctl 与 proc 展示。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119104208.782900-1-halg@google.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` deadline 带宽记账修正主系列 v10，联动 cpuset、rtmutex 并补齐自测。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795207232.git.mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com/)
- 重建调度域时去掉逐组冗余计算，降低大核数机器域重建的遍历开销。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bug-sched-fair-offline-active-v3-0-325e9eefa56d@linux.dev/)
- 同系列 v2：裁剪调度域重建中的按组工作，并处理 CPU 下线后的活跃状态。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261118-bug-sched-fair-offline-active-v2-0-b6ede596c6a6@linux.dev/)
- sched_ext 空闲路径不再把同步唤醒者排在更高调度类任务之后，附新自测。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-scx-fix75-v1-0-254f782ff9b0@gmail.com/)
- PSI 权限检查改为仅初始用户命名空间内的 CAP_SYS_RESOURCE 生效。[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120085135.40368-1-dennylin0707@gmail.com/)
- 另有 16 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121041507.39582-1-qyousef@layalina.io/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120014946.1355234-5-srikar@linux.ibm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120003534.1339296-5-srikar@linux.ibm.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120095559.429515-1-xavier.qyxia@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121031329.240177-1-longman@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120105822.7770-1-lshahed@amazon.de/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120095819.1009260-1-vincent.guittot@linaro.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119203825.2732984-1-vschneid@redhat.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795115075.git.mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795105408.git.mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795103339.git.mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795092090.git.mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com/) 等 16 项

## Observability
- `perf` feature：为 FUJITSU-MONAKA arm64 CPU 增加勘误规避，覆盖 cpucaps、屏障/原子操作与 GICv3 路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-monaka-fix-for-upstream-v3-0-057df4d2ca3c@fujitsu.com/)
- feature：扩展 Intel IFS 支持分组 In-Field Scan 与 Diamond Rapids，新增 stop_machine 与 trace 事件 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120175658.1147030-1-ehab.ababneh@intel.com/)
- `perf` feature：perf 采用内核 compiler-context-analysis 注解，提升编译器上下文分析与优化 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121065813.4143649-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `bugfix` bugfix：cpupower freq-set 修复释放后使用与过期频率限制 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-cpupower-freq-set-use-after-free-v4-1-928675d53a23@mailbox.org/)
- `perf` feature：新增 perf sysinfo 子命令，汇总 PMU 能力与内存/寄存器信息 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120222615.2291168-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` feature：支持按环境区分 PMU、共享 metric 事件并记录事件指标 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120221332.2245191-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` `other` other：perf symbol 改用有序数组与 DSO 持有的生命周期，缩小内存占用 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121071651.67118-1-irogers@google.com/)
- `perf` feature：为 CAN J1939 增加套接字与传输层 selftests [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-j1939-selftests-v5-0-fdf4c242a37e@pengutronix.de/)
- `perf` `bugfix` bugfix：引入 perf 覆盖率测试框架，并修复其发现的 annotate 等问题 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121032052.1392234-1-acme@kernel.org/)
- `perf` `other` other：rqspinlock 在队列头仍为尾部时继续抢占锁 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119023307.65178-1-jain.sm@gmail.com/)
- 另有 40 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119025941.87102-1-ljyoung04@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119164152.3678373-1-rhkrqnwk98@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119080139.131834-1-devnexen@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-bperf-attr-map-err-v1-1-b12b6b550273@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119172118.3416958-1-houminxi@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121003403.2928928-1-ihor.solodrai@linux.dev/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119031328.625-1-stitchqgwei@163.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-kselftest-run-timer-v2-0-9802690a370b@xs4all.nl/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120012553.3745742-1-jrhilke@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-i6500-cm3-pmu-v3-0-c86410934b51@mobileye.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119124319.3a8bfe50@gandalf.local.home/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120094934.979574-1-sunshaojie@kylinos.cn/) 等 40 项

## Virtualization
- `perf` ARM64 PMU 分区支持落地：vPMU 计数器可按 vCPU/组隔离，减少上下文切换开销并提升嵌套虚拟化性能 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119185215.632334-1-coltonlewis@google.com/)
- KVM x86/mmu 对非 guest_memfd 的私有 GFN 关闭大页恢复，防止私有内存映射层级被错误抬高 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-gmem-fix-gmem-max-mapping-level-v1-1-108788914fe8@google.com/)
- 新增 virtio-media 驱动及 uAPI，向 guest 暴露摄像头、编解码等媒体设备并支持零拷贝 scatterlist [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261121025007.3445723-1-briandaniels@google.com/)
- virtio-media 驱动 v11 版本，与 v12 同结构，主要差异在接口与打包细节 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120215916.3149345-1-briandaniels@google.com/)
- `bugfix` KVM x86 模拟器修复访问 MMIO 描述符表时的停滞，指令可正确重试推进 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119055747.23819-1-weichen.chen@linux.alibaba.com/)
- `bugfix` KVM x86 描述符表 MMIO 停滞修复的初版提交，逻辑与 v2 一致 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119032912.94364-1-weichen.chen@linux.alibaba.com/)
- `bugfix` 批量修正 KVM 文档与代码注释（api、halt-polling、locking、dirty ring 等），消除过时描述 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119074752.1027729-1-fuad.tabba@linux.dev/)
- `bugfix` vfio 修复 QEMU CPR 流程中未释放 KVM 引用导致的泄漏，覆盖多个 vfio 后端 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120154730.882393-1-andrey.drobyshev@virtuozzo.com/)
- 引入 Rust VFIO PCI 抽象与 NVIDIA vGPU 驱动，为 Rust 编写 VFIO 设备驱动提供总线层支撑 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119215046.2892839-1-xinmengs@nvidia.com/)
- mshv 在重复 hypercall 失败时仍走完成处理路径，避免 root 分区调用卡死 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120020858.3597446-1-mrathor@linux.microsoft.com/)
- 另有 4 项改动，详见：[↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119000151.442543-1-dmatlack@google.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119011149.534095-1-lcy8047@gmail.com/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119022615-mutt-send-email-mst@kernel.org/) [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/1B3A1B72438119BC+20261120033824.681219-1-raoxu@uniontech.com/)

## Networking
- `perf` 为 MHI 总线加入带宽投票，联动 PCIe 与 ath11k/ath12k 按需调整链路速率，兼顾吞吐与省电 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119-bwscale-v6-0-9a9a715fcb46@oss.qualcomm.com/)
- 为 Amlogic A9 CAN-FD 控制器新增驱动、DT 绑定与 arm64 板级节点 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120080820.3340646-1-zelong.dong@amlogic.com/)
- 为 SoC-e Ethernet switch IP 新增 DSA、MDIO 与 MFD 驱动及绑定 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120-devel-vstrassheim-soce-dsa-ml-v5-0-5de9225715e6@linutronix.de/)
- `perf` 引入 seccomp 经典 BPF 过滤缓存，减少重复安装与执行开销，并覆盖 io_uring、AF_PACKET 路径 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/cover.1795139109.git.xukuohai@huaweicloud.com/)
- `perf` `other` ceph/libceph 限制同步等待并加速网络中断后的恢复，减少卡死与重连延迟 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120073431.53636-1-ionut.nechita@windriver.com/)
- `perf` `other` SUNRPC 在休眠恢复后保持 NFS 客户端连接一致，减少重连与请求失败 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261119024719.311474-1-andrew@sericyb.com.au/)
- `perf` `other` 将 dst_entry 的 tclassid 与 __rcuref 拆到不同缓存行，避免高频更新下的伪共享 [↗](https://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20261120061604.3676605-1-jiebin.sun@intel.com/)
